messages:
anya (eng-ml): Quick thought — what if the transport layer carried an 'assist' header with per-shard progressive checksum+byte-range hints so loaders can start partial hydration before the full manifest is fetched? Could cut warmup by a lot on cold starts.

ryan (eng-runtime): Interesting. That'd push some metadata responsibility to transport — pros: immediate warmstart, cons: coupling transport formats. Do we have multipart/range-friendly transports in all deployments (Hosted/Dedicated/Private)?

sam (eng-ml): +1 for faster warmup, but we need a clear fallback when assist header is missing or partial. Also we must avoid duplicating authoritative manifest state.

eva (eng-oncall): From SRE side, need observability: count of assisted warmstarts vs fallback. Also consider if assist increases attack surface (signed blobs?).

loader-bot: deploy-check OK — suggested schema v0 includes fields: shard_id, start_offset, len, rolling_checksum, format_hint.

anya (eng-ml): Prototype idea: transport provides 'assist' for first N shards (configurable). Loader tries to range-fetch those byte-ranges and starts KV hydration; if checksum mismatch or missing range support, loader aborts and falls back to canonical manifest path. Abort must be idempotent.

ryan (eng-runtime): Abort path must be cheap. Also we can't assume object stores allow HTTP ranges in every environment. Need a capability bit in the assist header indicating range support + signedness.

sam (eng-ml): Implementation sketch:
```
assist_v0 {
  capability_mask: int,
  shards: [{id, offset, len, crc32, format_hint}],
}
```
Loader fallback: atomic switch to manifest when manifest arrives or checksum fails.

anya (eng-ml): Tradeoffs: extra header size per request, potential perf regression for small models. But for multi-GB checkpoints it's a big win. We should benchmark end-to-end.

eva (eng-oncall): Ops checklist: telemetry keys (assist_attempt, assist_success, assist_fallback_reason), rollout plan (canary on Dedicated first), opt-in feature flag + global kill-switch.

ryan (eng-runtime): Security: sign the assist header with transport token or include a short-lived connector signature. Private deployments may demand HSM-backed assertions.

sam (eng-ml): How do we version assist? Use a tiny TLV-style versioning so older loaders ignore unknown tags and new loaders can extend safely.

anya (eng-ml): Proposed action items:
- spike: add assist header in dev proxy (ryan)
- POC: loader tries range fetch + incremental hydration (sam)
- metrics: instrument assist telemetry (eva)
- rollout: canary plan + feature flag
I'll open tickets and drop PR links here.

eva (eng-oncall): Please add a minimal rollout doc — ops needs steps, monitoring thresholds and a kill-switch.

ryan (eng-runtime): I'll own the proxy change. @anya ping me when the spec lands.

sam (eng-ml): SGTM. If no blockers I'll start the POC tomorrow. :rocket:

anya (eng-ml): Thanks all — if anyone objects to pushing an early spike, speak up now. Otherwise I'll file the RFC follow-up with the sketch and a simple microbenchmark plan. :white_check_mark:
